title: Plant Manager
text:
**Job Description:** We are seeking a hands-on Plant Manager to lead all plant operations at Gates Washer. If you are a production manager, operations manager, or senior supervisor who understands the production and financial side of manufacturing and is ready to step up and run a plant, this is the right fit for you. This is the senior operations role at our facility, for someone who spends time on the floor, sets clear expectations, and builds a strong team. You will be responsible for quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and manufacturing costs.

**About our Company:**

**Who we are:** Gates Washer and Manufacturing Company, located right next to Chicago O’Hare and established in 1927, is a prominent name in specialty washers and light stampings. Our customers in the automotive, industrial, and aerospace sectors trust us for reliable products. With advanced automatic punch presses and our own tool room, we produce a wide range of parts from various metals and materials.

**Responsibilities:**

**Lead the Plant:** Manage all plant departments: punch presses, tool room, maintenance, tumbling, secondary operations, packaging, quality, shipping and receiving, and inventory.

**Run Daily Production:** Own the production schedule and daily priorities, balance labor and machine capacity, and keep work flowing to ship on time.

**Quality:** Serve as head of quality. Reduce scrap, rework, and customer returns, and make sure every job meets specification.

**People:** Hire, train, review, and when necessary let go of staff. Build cross-training and a bench of people for key positions.

**Cost and Budget:** Be responsible for parts of the P&L, including manufacturing expenses, labor, and productivity.

**Safety and Facility:** Own plant safety and compliance, keep equipment and the building maintained, and recommend equipment investments.

**Customers and Teamwork:** Work with sales and purchasing on quoting, material, and delivery dates, and deal directly with customers on quality and delivery issues.

**Reporting:** Report plant performance to ownership: on-time delivery, quality, productivity, and cost against budget.

**Continuous Improvement:** Write and maintain procedures, improve changeovers and uptime, and get the most out of our equipment.

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years in metal manufacturing, stamping, and fabrication. Machine shop or automotive supplier experience also considered.
* 5 or more years leading people, including at least 2 to 3 years managing a team of 10 or more.
* Working knowledge of tooling, dies, and tool room practices.
* Hands-on quality experience under a formal system such as ISO 9001.
* Experience managing budget or manufacturing costs.
* Experience hiring, reviewing, and managing performance.
* Comfortable with production metrics and an ERP or scheduling system.
* Stamping or punch press experience is preferred but not required.
* A degree is preferred but not required.
* Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

**Base Salary:** $125,000–$130,000 per year.

**Annual Performance Bonus: $15,000–$20,000**

.

**Long-Term Incentive Bonus:**

Share in the company's growth and success. If Gates increases in value over the next five years, you receive a share of that increase, with the potential for a six-figure payout.

Pay: $125,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Plant management: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
